maddeler.e:
أتواطأ (form VI)
# أَتَوَاطَأُ (ʔatawāṭaʔu) /ʔa.ta.waː.tˤa.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# أَتَوَاطَأَ (ʔatawāṭaʔa) /ʔa.ta.waː.tˤa.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
# أَتَوَاطَأْ (ʔatawāṭaʔ) /ʔa.ta.waː.tˤaʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَوَاطَأَ (tawāṭaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
